{{Current events|year=2021|month=03|day=21|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Russian–Syrian hospital bombing campaign]]
***Seven [[civilian]]s are killed and 16 others are wounded in a Syrian government airstrike on a hospital in [[Atareb]], [[Aleppo Governorate]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/21/syria-several-killed-in-govt-attack-on-hospital-in-idlib (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Russian Air Force|Russian]] jets strike gas facilities in the town of [[Sarmada]], [[Idlib Governorate]], near the [[Syria–Turkey border|border]] with [[Turkey]], and strike [[Qah]] with a [[surface-to-surface missile]], according to the Turkish [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|Ministry of National Defense]]. Turkey says it has sent a statement to Russia asking for the attacks to stop immediately. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-idlib/russian-jets-hit-civilian-areas-near-turkish-border-witnesses-and-rebels-say-idUSKBN2BD0E2?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Afghan peace process]]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Lloyd Austin]] makes an unannounced trip to [[Afghanistan]] ahead of a [[2021 withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan|May 1 deadline]] to [[Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan|withdraw]] troops from the country. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Politics/defense-secretary-lloyd-austin-visits-afghanistan-troop-withdrawal/story?id=76557517 (ABC News)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***Suspected [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]-linked militants kill 22 people in a series of raids on three villages in [[Tahoua Region]], [[Niger]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-security/at-least-22-killed-in-niger-village-attacks-sources-say-idUSKBN2BD0SS?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Turkish lira]] plunges by 15% after [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] fires [[List of Governors of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey|Governor of the Central Bank]] [[Naci Ağbal]]. He is replaced by Erdoğan ally [[Şahap Kavcıoğlu]]. [https://www.bloombergquint.com/onweb/turkey-bulls-are-wrong-footed-after-central-bank-hawk-s-ouster (Bloomberg)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Rajasthan]]
*****The [[Rajasthan]] [[Government of Rajasthan|state government]] imposes a [[curfew]] in [[Ajmer]], [[Bhilwara]], [[Jaipur]], [[Jodhpur]], [[Kota, Rajasthan|Kota]], [[Udaipur]], [[Sagwara]], and [[Kushalgarh]] from 11:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]] beginning tomorrow. The government will also require travelers from other [[States and union territories of India|state]]s to carry a negative [[PCR]] [[COVID-19 testing|test]] from the previous 72 hours beginning March 25 due to an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/jaipur-news/covid19-negative-rt-pcr-report-mandatory-for-rajasthan-travellers-night-curfew-in-8-cities-101616328410368-amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Government of the Philippines|government]] places the provinces of [[Bulacan]], [[Cavite]], [[Laguna (province)|Laguna]], and [[Rizal]] under the "general community quarantine" and bans all mass gatherings and cross-border travel in those provinces from tomorrow until April 4. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/duterte-gcq-metro-manila-bulacan-cavite-laguna-rizal-march-2021 (Rappler)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] surpasses 300,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [http://www.bta.bg/en/c/DF/id/2382639 (Bulgarian News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****The number of [[COVID-19]] patients in the [[Intensive care unit|ICU]] reaches a record 1,334 people. [https://www.europafm.ro/nou-bilant-covid-1334-pacienti-internati-la-terapie-intensiva-cel-mai-mare-numar-de-la-inceputul-pandemiei/ (Europa FM)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 33 deaths in the past 24 hours, the lowest daily total since October 5. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-britain-data/uk-reports-33-new-covid-19-deaths-lowest-daily-number-since-october-idUSKBN2BD0LL (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] surpasses three million cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-reports-over-20000-new-covid-19-cases-in-past-24-hours/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****[[Florida]] becomes the first [[U.S. state]] to surpasses 1,000 cases of SARS-CoV-2 variants. [https://www.tallahassee.com/story/news/2021/03/21/florida-first-state-cross-1-000-mark-coronavirus-variant-cases/4793746001/ (''Tallahassee Democrat'')] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]], [[501.V2 variant]]
***[[South Africa]] concludes the sale of their [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccines]] to the [[African Union]] after the country stopped using these vaccines because they were found to be not highly effective against the 501.V2 variant. [https://www.news24.com/amp/news24/southafrica/news/covid-19-sale-of-astrazeneca-vaccine-to-au-concluded-health-minister-zweli-mkhize-20210321 (News24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Republic of the Congo presidential election]]
**Citizens in the [[Republic of the Congo]] head to the polls to elect their President. Incumbent [[Denis Sassou Nguesso]] is expected to extend his 36-year rule as his main rival [[Guy Brice Parfait Kolélas]] remains hospitalized in [[France]], where he was evacuated after contracting [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congorepublic-election/sassou-expected-to-extend-36-year-rule-as-congo-republic-votes-idUSKBN2BD05Q (Reuters)]
